maker: HPT (L. Wang, X. Chen, J. Zhao, K. He)
name: HPT-Base
family: Heterogeneous pre-trained transformer policy (ResNet18 stem, 12.6M-parameter trunk)

sources.title: L. Wang, X. Chen, J. Zhao, K. He, Scaling Proprioceptive-Visual Learning with Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformers, arXiv:2409.20537 (HTML version)
sources.covers: the 224 × 224 resize into a ResNet18, one camera view by default, the action horizon 8, the inference rate on an RTX 3070, the 10 Hz real-world control

note: HPT resizes each image to 224 × 224 (cv2.resize: stretched, the aspect ratio is not kept) and encodes it with a frozen ResNet18 into a 7 × 7 feature map; a cross-attention stem maps every view's features to N_v = 16 vision tokens (all views together), so tokens_per_image is null and patch_px does not apply. One camera view by default ("1 camera v.s. 2 cameras" in the real-world transfer). A fixed action horizon of 8 and an observation horizon of 4. Timing: "39Hz for HPT-base" in the real world including all pre-processing and the encoders, on "an old NVIDIA RTX 3070 GPU" (25.6 ms; in simulation transfer 47 Hz); "A modern GPU such as A100 will likely improve the speed by 3-4 times" (not entered). The trunk sizes run from HPT-Small (3.1M) to HPT-Huge (1.1B); this entry is the Base trunk the timing names.

input_resolution.quote: "we resize each image to the standard square size (224x224) before feeding into a ResNet18"

crop_rule.quote: normalize_image_numpy: "The input image is resized to (224, 224) using cv2.resize." (image = cv2.resize(image, (224, 224)))

patch_px.quote: Not a ViT: a ResNet18 "7x7 vision modality token".

tokens_per_image.quote: Not per image: the stem maps all views to "N_v=16" tokens by default.

n_cameras.quote: "By default, we use one camera view of the scene with the pre-trained frozen ResNet18 image encode"

action_chunk.quote: "we pick a fixed action horizon (length 8) and observation horizon (length 4) for each embodiment"

inference_ms.quote: "The inference time, which includes all the pre-processing and encoder time, on the local computer with an old NVIDIA RTX 3070 GPU is 39Hz for HPT-base" (1000 / 39 = 25.6 ms)

control_hz.quote: "The episode lengths of real-world teleoperation vary from 50 steps to 150 steps with 10 Hz control frequencies."
